Faceless God — Innate Technique (6th level)

At 6th level, the percent of Mental Corruption you can force on a creature increases to 50% and increases by 25% again at 11th level and 18th level. The die size for Paranoia and Madness decreases with every 25% increase and at 100% it happens automatically. At 90% you fall further into madness and must make a Wisdom saving throw at the beginning of your turn, moving in a random direction on a failed save.
